player_intro: (DeckTech handle '''helsbly''') posted a [[Light]] list on DeckTech in March 2001.
description: An almost un defeated light deck.
shields_note: The post names no Defensive Shields.
notes: The draft had side Dark; every card is Light and the post is tagged Light, so the deck is Light. Total 60 as published (the 'Interupts (53)' header covers Ewok Catapult, which is an Endor automated weapon, not an Interrupt).

Posted starting location 'Yavin 4 Massassai Base' matches no card exactly (Light Yavin 4 sites include Massassi Throne Room, Massassi War Room, Massassi Ruins and Massassi Headquarters); left UNKNOWN as posted, so starting.card is empty.
Posted 'Anger, Feat, Agression' dested the Light Dagobah Effect Anger, Fear, Aggression; 'Suprise Assault' Surprise Assault.
Novelty list (15-19 copies of single cards) posted as a real deck; kept as published.
